callouts.name: Energy
callouts.why: Energy zone on the west edge.

callouts.name: A Ammo
callouts.why: Ammo zone on the A side, tucked under the south flank of the main ship hull.

callouts.name: B Ammo
callouts.why: Ammo zone on the B side, north of the main ship hull.

callouts.name: B Cap
callouts.why: Capture zone on the B (north) side, beside the small ship thruster wreck.

callouts.name: A Cap
callouts.why: Capture zone on the A (south) side; the A heal zone sits on its north edge.

callouts.name: A Spawn
callouts.why: A team spawn dome

callouts.name: Ridge
callouts.why: Raised ground behind the ridge wall leading out of B spawn.

callouts.name: Wreck
callouts.why: Broken-off ship section lying in the south-west.

callouts.name: Shelf
callouts.why: East edge strip north of the A spawn dome, among the comm spires.

callouts.name: Teeth
callouts.why: Row of dragon's teeth tank traps west of the centre.

callouts.name: Turrets
callouts.why: Raised strip east of the ridge wall with the row of turret bases.

callouts.name: East Lane
callouts.why: Strip between the ridge wall and the east edge, south of Turrets.

callouts.name: Ship
callouts.why: Open ground along the south-west side of the big crashed ship hull.

callouts.name: Knoll
callouts.why: Small hill between Wreck and A Cap.

callouts.name: Mound
callouts.why: Low hill on the west side, between Teeth and Energy.

callouts.name: Rock
callouts.why: Rock outcrop in the middle of the north-west rise.

callouts.name: Hump
callouts.why: Bushy hill north of Mid, between B Ammo and Rock.

callouts.name: Spires
callouts.why: Comm spires in the south-east corner, around the A spawn dome.

callouts.name: Wall
callouts.why: West foot of the ridge wall, south half.

callouts.name: Thicket
callouts.why: Biggest bush cluster on the map, south-west.

callouts.name: Mid
callouts.why: Bare low ground at the map centre, north-west of the ship hull.

callouts.name: West Basin
callouts.why: Low ground on the west edge north of Energy.

callouts.name: Arch
callouts.why: Arched section of the ridge wall, north half.

callouts.name: B Yard
callouts.why: Open ground on the west side of B Cap (the B heal zone sits inside the B Cap region).

callouts.name: Corner
callouts.why: North-west corner of the map.
